outcome: Need for tumor resection after birth
cohort: This study included nine fetuses who underwent Ex Utero Intrapartum Treatment (EXIT) procedures between 2003 and 2018 for congenital high airway obstruction syndrome or neck masses.
finding: The Ex Utero Intrapartum Treatment (EXIT) procedure was effective and could be performed safely in the airway management of fetuses with suspected airway obstruction.
